attack_surface.migration_detail: 7 nullable TEXT columns on operator_queue (sync_state/sync_detail/sync_updated_at/last_confirmed_at, delivery_state/delivery_detail/delivery_updated_at); both tracks; Alembic re-chained to 0072_operator_queue_sync_state on 0071_seat_decisions (single head verified)
new_agent_controlled_inputs: file entry `status` (folded through ^[a-z_]{1,32}$ or `other` before it becomes sync_detail)
file entry title/question/options/expires_at (compared through a pure fingerprint; never stored again; only the changed FIELD NAMES are recorded)
file entry `platform` block (only the presence of `aging_since` is read, to decide the one receipt write; never read back as authorization)
agent-server `PUT /api/files?if_match=` (sha256 hex compared to the on-disk text; a mismatch is 412; not a secret)
file entry `type` (agent-authored, unbounded at ingest and at the DB sink — pre-existing column; the NEW audit copy is folded, see finding F1)
attack_surface.changed_response_surface: GET /api/operator-queue and /{id} gain sync_state/sync_detail/sync_updated_at/last_confirmed_at, delivery_state/delivery_detail/delivery_updated_at, aging/aged_since; the list gains undelivered_count/closed_by_filer_count (scoped by the caller's accessible set; admin unscoped by design). POST …/respond and the portal answer return 409 item_diverged (operator body: sync_state+sync_detail — the same principal can GET them; portal body: coarse sync only). Portal WorkspaceAsk gains sync (coarse enum) + aging (bool). New ops setting operator_queue_aging_hours (admin-gated ops/config, validated 0-8760; 422-blocked on the generic PUT /settings/{key} by OPS_SETTINGS_VALIDATION membership).
attack_surface.new_broadcast: operator_queue_sync — one thin trigger per poll cycle, empty payload, allow-listed as fleet-level in tests/unit/test_ent467_ws_agent_scope.py with its reason; listeners refetch the access-controlled list

fixed_during_audit.category: agent-authored text into a durable operator-visible sink (G-04 class)
fixed_during_audit.title: the new `ingested` audit row copied the entry's unbounded `type` into audit_log.details
fixed_during_audit.evidence: _clamp_ingested_item bounds title/question/context/options/priority/created_at, never `type`; db/operator_queue.py:216 stores item.get('type','question') with no belt; platform_audit_service.log:186 json.dumps(details) with no cap; audit_log is append-only, hash-chained (#2015) and un-prunable for 365 days
fixed_during_audit.exploit: agent writes an id-shaped entry with a ~2 MB `type` -> 5 s sync ingests it -> _audit_sync('ingested', …, {'type': <string>}) persists it chain-hashed and undeletable for a year; impact = log-content injection + storage amplification into an immutable table (no auth/control-flow effect, no XSS: Audit.vue renders details in <pre>, no MCP/LLM reader of audit rows in-repo)
fixed_during_audit.fix: details['type'] = _fold_agent_status(clamped.get('type')) — ^[a-z_]{1,32}$ or `other`; test_the_ingested_audit_row_carries_no_agent_text pins it with a 5 KB hostile type (asserts `other` and a <200-byte details payload)
fixed_during_audit.residual: operator_queue.type itself stays unbounded at ingest and at the DB sink (pre-existing, prunable/clearable, rendered as text) — registered in the debt inbox, not introduced by this branch

closed_pre_existing_integrity_defects: invalid JSON in the agent's queue file was read as an EMPTY request list and the write-back then overwrote the file with the reconstructed responses alone (data loss of every pending entry on a torn write) — now `unconfirmed:invalid_json` and no write that cycle
expiry ran after the no-running-agents early return, so an all-stopped fleet never expired anything — hoisted

a pending entry re-using a terminal row's id was re-created every cycle (on-conflict returns the old uuid silently): a phantom admit against the #1632 depth cap + an `operator_queue_new` broadcast per cycle — now `stale_id`
appendix: `if_match` compare uses `==` on hex digests — a timing side channel could only reveal the hash of a file the caller can already read; excluded (no secret)
the atomic write's temp file name embeds the pid in the agent's own home directory — the agent server runs as the same user; no boundary is crossed; excluded

supply_chain_summary.node: unchanged (jsdom/@vue/test-utils installed on the host from the tracked npm lockfile via pnpm import; manifests untouched)
